item.title: dotnet: use brotli from nixpkgs instead of vendored copy
item.description:
Part of #578375.

The .NET source build bundles a copy of the brotli decoder in src/runtime/src/native/external/brotli. After this change, an update of brotli in nixpkgs also updates the decoder of .NET. Thus the fix of CVE-2026-111497 comes with brotli 1.2.1 (#577208), which is in staging.

This change fixes:

  • crossmacro
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_10.vmr
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_10_0_4xx.vmr
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_11.vmr
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_9.vmr
  • helion
  • lumafly
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_10.packages.Microsoft-NETCore-App-Host-linux-x64
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_10_0_4xx.packages.Microsoft-NETCore-App-Host-linux-x64
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_9.packages.Microsoft-NETCore-App-Host-linux-x64
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_10.packages.Microsoft-NETCore-App-Runtime-linux-x64
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_10_0_4xx.packages.Microsoft-NETCore-App-Runtime-linux-x64
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_9.packages.Microsoft-NETCore-App-Runtime-linux-x64
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_10.packages.Microsoft-NETCore-App-Runtime-NativeAOT-linux-x64
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_10_0_4xx.packages.Microsoft-NETCore-App-Runtime-NativeAOT-linux-x64
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_11.packages.Microsoft-NETCore-App-Runtime-NativeAOT-linux-x64
  • officecli
  • rockstarlang
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_9.packages.runtime-linux-x64-Microsoft-DotNet-ILCompiler
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_10_0_4xx.packages.runtime-linux-x64-Microsoft-NETCore-DotNetAppHost
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_10.packages.runtime-linux-x64-Microsoft-NETCore-DotNetAppHost
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_9.packages.runtime-linux-x64-Microsoft-NETCore-DotNetAppHost
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_8.vmr
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_8.packages.Microsoft-NETCore-App-Crossgen2-linux-x64
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_11.packages.Microsoft-NETCore-App-Host-linux-x64
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_8.packages.Microsoft-NETCore-App-Host-linux-x64
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_11.packages.Microsoft-NETCore-App-Runtime-linux-x64
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_8.packages.Microsoft-NETCore-App-Runtime-linux-x64
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_11.packages.runtime-linux-x64-Microsoft-NETCore-DotNetAppHost
  • dotnetCorePackages.dotnet_8.packages.runtime-linux-x64-Microsoft-NETCore-DotNetAppHost

Note, there are 7 more .NET packages that will likely need a separate fix:

  • naps2: ships its own .NET Core 2.1 native library through deps.json
  • melonloader-installer, pupdate, tkmm: single-file bundles; nothing visible to the scanner before or after, needs further examination
  • powershell and the cwtools vscode extension: they do not rebuild with this change at all, their runtime does not come from the source SDK.
  • slsk-batchdl: downloads older Microsoft runtime packs from NuGet, the copy comes from there.

[!NOTE] AI Disclosure: Claude Code made the code change, the commit message and the first version of this pull request description, with patchix. Claude Code used Claude Opus 5.5. This pull request description is written in ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English), examined with memelint in strict mode. As the automation/AI policy requires, I established confidence in this output: by manual review of the code change and of this description, and with the verification tooling that this description discloses.

Test

See https://gist.github.com/irgolic/1a4d2c41462be01a97a9765316bafb34 for the test outputs; they were too long to fit in the PR description.

Before the change, the scanner finds the bundled decoder in libSystem.IO.Compression.Native.so and singlefilehost. After the change, these files import libbrotlidec.so of nixpkgs.

After the change, the scanner shows two files as copies with an unknown version. System.IO.Compression.Brotli.dll is a .NET assembly with no native code: it has only the names of the native functions. libSystem.IO.Compression.Native.a of NativeAOT has only pal_zlib.c.o and entrypoints.c.o. nm shows references to the brotli functions, but no definition.

item.description:

VLC 3.0.24 is a major security update, with over 130 security fixes across VLC and its bundled libraries. It upgrades FFmpeg from 4.4 to 8.1.2 and updates 49 third-party libraries. New features include ATRAC decoding, CEA-708 captions in MP4, SRT listener mode and NV12 DirectShow capture on Windows. This release also fixes slow Windows startup when Daylight Saving Time changes and a MIDI playback crash on macOS 26 and later. More details on the release page. item.title: python3Packages.wassima: use cacert bundle instead of vendored CA list
item.description:
Part of #576541.

wassima has a bundled CA list, as a Python string in wassima/_os/_embed.py, and this list has the eMudhra roots that cacert removed. In postPatch, this change removes the list and makes _embed.py read the ca-bundle.crt file of cacert. A symlink cannot replace the list, because the list is a string in the code, not a file.

[!NOTE] AI Disclosure: Claude Code made the code change, the commit message and the first version of this pull request description, with patchix. Claude Code used Claude Opus 5.5. This pull request description is written in ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English), examined with memelint in strict mode. item.title: gnustep-base: use cacert bundle instead of vendored CA file
item.description:
Part of #576541.

gnustep-base has a bundled CA file, GSTLS/ca-certificates.crt, in the resource bundle of the library, in the lib output. When the GSTLSCAFile user default, GS_TLS_CA_FILE and SSL_CERT_FILE are not set, GSTLS gives this file to GnuTLS as the default CA file. GSTLS uses the file when it checks the certificate of a server. By default, GNUstep does not check server certificates, thus to use the file, an application must set GSTLSVerifyServer, GS_TLS_VERIFY_S or the GSTLSVerify option of a request. This change replaces the file with a symlink to the ca-bundle.crt file of cacert in postInstall.

item.description:
Part of #576541.

Ren'Py has a bundled CA file, share/renpy/lib/python3.12/certifi/cacert.pem, from the upstream SDK. This file is part of the Python interpreter of the SDK, share/renpy/lib/py3-linux-x86_64/python. item.title: flyspray: use cacert bundle instead of vendored CA bundle
item.description:
Part of #576541.

Flyspray installs a copy of the Guzzle 3 PHP library. This library has a bundled CA file, vendor/guzzle/guzzle/src/Guzzle/Http/Resources/cacert.pem. item.description:
Part of #576541.

The Julia packages that generic.nix builds from source, julia_110 through julia_113, have a bundled CA file, share/julia/cert.pem. NetworkOptions.jl uses this file when JULIA_SSL_CA_ROOTS_PATH, SSL_CERT_FILE and SSL_CERT_DIR are not set and the system has no CA bundle, for example in build sandboxes and containers. Before this change, generic.nix uses cacert only during the build, and the installed cert.pem is the bundled file. For julia, this file has 121 certificates, and emSign ECC Root CA - G3 is one of them. This change replaces cert.pem with a symlink to the ca-bundle.crt file of cacert in postInstall. This is the same change as #577130 for the Julia binary packages.

item.description:
Part of #576541.

CudaText has bundled copies of requests, urllib3 and certifi in share/cudatext/py/sys/. The cuda_addonman package of CudaText uses requests.get to get the files of extensions. item.title: pur: use cacert bundle instead of vendored CA bundle
item.description:
Part of #576541.

pur bundles a copy of pip 23.2.1 in pur/packages. That copy has certifi 2023.5.7, with the file pip/_vendor/certifi/cacert.pem. pur puts pur/packages first in sys.path. Thus the bundled requests reads this file for all HTTPS connections. The file has 141 certificates. 24 of them are not in cacert, and 18 are in cacert but not for TLS. The file contains the roots AAA Certificate Services and emSign ECC Root CA - G3. This change replaces the file with a symlink to ${cacert}/etc/ssl/certs/ca-bundle.crt in postInstall. The rm command stops the build when a new version moves the file.

[!NOTE] AI Disclosure: Claude Code made the code change, the commit message and the first version of this pull request description, through patchix. Claude Code used Claude Opus 5.5.
